payload.headline: po-20260720T052606 is UNDELIVERABLE BY CONSTRUCTION, and the defect it describes MUTATED today into a form its fix would not match.

finding_1_undeliverable_recipient.what: Row po-20260720T052606 is addressed to=unified-agent and has been status=NEW for 38 hours. It is not awaiting triage — unified-agent has NO reader for this channel. grep for signal_queue across all of docs/agents/unified-agent/ returns ZERO hits.
finding_1_undeliverable_recipient.positive_control: The identical grep against docs/agents/po/ and docs/agents/system-auditor/ returns 5 files, so the query works and the zero is a real absence, not a broken pattern.
finding_1_undeliverable_recipient.consequence: Every dish cycle since 2026-07-20T05:26Z ran WITHOUT this guidance, and every future one will. Chef-evening fired at 19:45Z today without it. Leaving the row NEW does not preserve it for the recipient; the recipient cannot read it in any state.
finding_1_undeliverable_recipient.why_this_matters_beyond_one_row: The signal_queue routing table permits addressing to=unified-agent, but no unified-agent flow consumes it. The addressing surface is wider than the reader surface, so a row can be well-formed, correctly routed, and structurally undeliverable at the same time. Recommend PO audit which of the 4 permitted cowork recipients {po, tran-ngoc-bau, unified-agent, alert-commander} actually have readers before more rows are addressed to them.
finding_1_undeliverable_recipient.the_only_real_channel_to_chef: unified-agent takes instruction from its flow docs. So chef.md IS the delivery mechanism, and FIX-CHEF-L6-GOLD-FALSE-PREDICATE is the only vehicle that can land this. The signal row was never viable.

finding_2_defect_mutated_fix_would_miss_.what: The gold L6 false predicate is STILL LIVE and its newest instance POSTDATES the PO row by a day. It has changed shape.

evidence_by_dish.2026-07-19-evening: [L6-gap: gold >$4,300 active — regime-drift risk: gold 4018.8 nearing psychological...] — DEFECT, and internally self-contradictory: asserts >$4,300 active while quoting 4018.8 in the same string.
evidence_by_dish.2026-07-20-morning: [L6-gap: gold >$4300 active — regime-drift risk: gold-driven phase may lag actual...] — DEFECT, pure literal paste, no price cited.
evidence_by_dish.2026-07-21-morning: [gap:gold_4300_active] — Gold at $4053 signals safe-haven demand; monitor... — DEFECT, MUTATED FORM. TODAY.

finding_2_defect_mutated_fix_would_miss_.the_critical_warning: The 2026-07-21 instance no longer contains the literal string that PO row and FIX-CHEF-L6-GOLD-FALSE-PREDICATE target. The label collapsed to gold_4300_active (underscore form) and the body now DOES cite the live price ($4053). So a fix implemented as a grep/strip of the literal >$4,300 active WILL MISS the current live form. The false assertion migrated from the body into the KEY NAME while the body self-corrected.
finding_2_defect_mutated_fix_would_miss_.what_the_fix_must_actually_do: Match on the semantic claim (any assertion that the 4300 threshold is active/breached) rather than on the template string. Note the partial self-correction is real progress — the agent is now computing and citing the live price — so the fix should preserve that behaviour and correct only the label, NOT strip gold handling wholesale.
finding_2_defect_mutated_fix_would_miss_.recurrence_shape: Intermittent, as PO's payload already stated. Fired in 2 of the last 5 dated dishes. Not converging on its own.
finding_2_defect_mutated_fix_would_miss_.correction_to_my_own_earlier_report: I reported at tick 18:15Z that the last four dishes were clean and graded this as non-urgent at a rate of 3/18. The 2026-07-21-morning instance falsifies that: the defect fired TODAY. My earlier census missed it because I searched for the literal token form and the instance had mutated. I made, on this exact finding, the same error I am now warning the fix implementer about.

payload.not_asserted: Chef-evening 19:45Z output is NOT yet examined — it fires as this tick closes. Whether it carries the token is unknown and is NOT claimed either way here. Next tick should check docs/data/unified-agent-synthesis-2026-07-21-evening.json.

Did NOT edit chef.md (flow-doc surgery is agent-father scope). Did NOT flip the row status (recipient cannot read it in any state, and PO recorded it as deliberately LEFT NEW). Did NOT mint a board row (minting is PO's).
